when_used: The proprietor of two or more parcels registered in the same name applies for them to be combined into one title.

body_text.text: The parcels comprised in the above-mentioned Title (s) are registered in the name of the same Proprietor(s).
The Proprietor(s) HEREBY APPLY for the parcels to be combined in the following manner:**

foot_notes: **Attach a Cadastral Map and a Cadastral Plan.
***The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.”

custom_fields.name: combination_schedule
custom_fields.label: How the parcels are to be combined
custom_fields.prompt: The parcels as they are to stand after the combination. One parcel per line, the cells separated by a pipe: cadastral plan number | parcel number | area (approximately)
